summary.headline: Planetary Significations in Houses Eleven and Twelve
summary.text: Planetary significations in the eleventh and twelfth houses: friends, wealth, honors, hopes, enemies, servants, captivity, poverty, disease, marriage, and the native’s skills or disturbances.
